Meta Quest 3 (512 GB).description: VR glasses - stand-alone, LCD display, 120 Hz refresh rate, with microphone, WiFi and USB-C connection, 110° field of view, Snapdragon XR2 Gen 2, 512 GB storage, 8 GB RAM, weight 0.515 kg, white color, controller included
descriptions: With the new generation of the Oculus Quest 3 headset, breathtaking gaming and multimedia experiences await you. Overall, it is a complete technological leader with massive support among game and application developers. This is the first headset ever to offer you full-fledged AR in addition to VR. Two color RGB cameras combined with a depth projector provide full-color, high-fidelity views of your surroundings and manage the blending of virtual and physical spaces.
Key features of the Meta Quest 3 VR glasses (512 GB)

• Resolution (total) - 4,128 × 2,208 px
  • Resolution (per eye) - 2,064 × 2,208 px
  • Refresh rate 120 Hz
  • Qualcomm Snapdragon XR2 Gen2 processor
  • RAM capacity 8 GB
  • 512GB integrated storage
  • Bluetooth, USB-TC connection
  • Sensors - accelerometer, magnetometer, gyroscopic sensor
  • Suitable for virtual and augmented/mixed reality
  • Battery life up to 3 hours on a single charge
  • The Oculus Quest 3 includes an integrated microphone
  • Also suitable for people who wear glasses
  • Free Oculus app and mobile devices required for initial setup
Oculus Quest 3 has a 120Hz HDR display

The display is also completely new with a higher resolution of 2,208 × 2,064 pixels at 120 Hz, which is significantly more pixels compared to the previous generation. The Oculus Quest 3 can also be a great device not only for exploring virtual worlds, but also for watching movies thanks to support for displaying HDR10+ content. The new Touch Plus controllers offer a modified design based on the appearance of the Quest 3. The absence of a ring with sensors around the top of the controller will please, making the controllers smaller and better to hold. Functional innovations include the TruTouch haptic response or a pressure sensor in the thumb area, which is able to recognize how tightly you hold the controller.
